answer: The spiral lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the mesa is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Reaching the kernel of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
